title: Estimating Accurate Hand Pose in Camera Space with Vision Transformer
abstract: arXiv:2609.24424v2 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Monocular RGB-based hand pose estimation has emerged as a critical research frontier in computer vision. The local hand pose estimation methods predict hand poses relative to the wrist, while global hand pose estimation also requires estimating the wrist's position in the camera coordinate system. However, this camera-space estimation confronts two fundamental challenges: (1) depth ambiguity in monocular settings, and (2) the coupling effect of hand local poses and global wrist positions in the perspective projections. In particular, this coupling reflects that the projections are jointly determined by local hand poses, wrist positions, and camera intrinsics. To overcome these challenges, our framework proposes two key innovations: Transformation-Isomorphism Supervision for hand-depth information extraction and Perspective Information Embedding for resolving above coupling effect of local pose and wrist position, both integrated within

translated_title: 使用视觉Transformer在相机空间中估计精确的手部姿态
translated_abstract: 基于单目RGB的手部姿态估计已成为计算机视觉领域的关键研究前沿。局部手部姿态估计方法预测相对于手腕的手部姿态，而全局手部姿态估计还需要估计手腕在相机坐标系中的位置。然而，这种相机空间估计面临两个基本挑战：（1）单目设置中的深度歧义性，（2）手部局部姿态与全局手腕位置在透视投影中的耦合效应。特别是，这种耦合反映在投影由局部手部姿态、手腕位置和相机内参共同决定。为了克服这些挑战，我们的框架提出了两项关键创新：用于手部深度信息提取的变换同构监督，以及用于解决上述局部姿态与手腕位置耦合效应的透视信息嵌入，两者均集成于……
tldr: 本文提出基于视觉Transformer的手部姿态估计框架，通过变换同构监督和透视信息嵌入两项创新，解决了单目RGB手部姿态估计中的深度歧义以及局部姿态与手腕位置耦合的两大挑战，实现了相机空间中精确的全局手部姿态估计。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a Vision Transformer-based framework for accurate global hand pose estimation in camera space, addressing depth ambiguity and the coupling between local hand poses and wrist positions through Transformation-Isomorphism Supervision and Perspective Information Embedding.
